description: E14-02 natural-language modelling cases in the E14-10 formulation case format (benchmarks/e14_spec/formulation.py), extended with the compiler-only outcome compile_failed. Every reply is SCRIPTED: these cases exercise the compiler plumbing and say nothing about the accuracy of a real language model, which E14-10 measures.
